title: SSC CGL Quant
summary: SSC CGL Tier I Quantitative Aptitude past questions from 112 shifts, 2023 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 113 Tier I shifts, 2023 to 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC writes fresh questions for almost every shift, so most of the order comes from question types. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
